column1: # Builder B (Claude Sonnet, independent instance), 2026-11-20. TLV value bytes for the mld group.
# Sources: spec-b10.md packet (EasyMesh tables 17.2.75, 17.2.84, 17.2.85, 17.2.96 to 17.2.103, section 3.1.2), note 0009 decisions
#   D2/D3/D4/D5/D6/D8/A8 as quoted in the packet, audit rows lines 18-24, 228-233, 252-256, 278-296 as quoted in the packet.
#   Bytes derived by /tmp scratchpad script from the fields column; no other builder's work was read.
# 0xb7: Num_Radio(1), per radio RUID(6) Num_BSS(1), per BSS BSSID(6) flags(1: bh b7 fh b6 r1 b5 r2 b4 multi b3 tx b2 rsv b1-0) rsv(1) SSIDlen(1) SSID(n).
# 0xbb, 0xbd: raw DPP attribute octets (at least 1), no framing added.

# 0xe0: Num_APMLD(1), per MLD valid(1: b7) SSIDlen(1) SSID(n) MAC(6) modes(1: str b7 nstr b6 emlsr b5 emlmr b4) rsv(20) Num_Aff(1), per aff flags(1: mac b7 linkid b6) RUID(6) MAC(6) LinkID(1) rsv(18).
# 0xe1: flags(1: bsta b7 ap b6) bSTA_MLD(6) AP_MLD(6) modes(1) rsv(17) Num_Aff(1), per aff valid(1: b7) RUID(6) MAC(6) rsv(19). Empty value is the lenient form.
# 0xe2: STA_MLD(6) AP_MLD(6) modes(1) rsv(18) Num_Aff(1), per aff BSSID(6) STA MAC(6) rsv(19).
# 0xe3: MLD(6) rsv(25) Num_Aff(1), per aff MAC(6) rsv(26).
# 0xe4: STA(6) 5 x u32 big-endian (BytesSent, BytesReceived, PacketsSent, PacketsReceived, PacketsSentErrors) then n>=0 expansion octets.

# 0xe5: BSSID(6) 9 x u32 big-endian (PacketsSent, PacketsReceived, PacketSentErrors, UnicastSent, UnicastReceived, MulticastSent, MulticastReceived, BroadcastSent, BroadcastReceived) then n>=0 expansion octets.

# 0xe6: hdr(1: is_bSTA b7) MLD(6) neg(1: b7) rsv(22) Num_Mapping(2, little-endian), per mapping add(1: b7) STA_MLD(6) control(1: dir b7-6 default b5 switch b4 expdur b3 size b2) presence(1) Expected_Duration(3, big-endian) 2 x popcount(presence) TID map octets (raw) rsv(7).

# 0xe7: rsv(32) Num_Radio(1), per radio RUID(6) Num_BSS(1), per BSS BSSID(6) flags(1: opinfo b7 disabled b6 pe b5 bulimit b4 exponent b3-2 rsv b1-0) MCS/NSS(4 raw) Control(1) CCFS0(1) CCFS1(1) Bitmap(2 raw) rsv(16), then per radio rsv(25).

# Reading rules: an absent reserved mask/octet/block writes zeros; an absent non-reserved item ends the bytes; a hex: item shorter than its width is written and ends the bytes; a row with only kind/error/decoded items has an empty value.
